structured.answer: I saw that Harel has many products, and in its קופת גמל להשקעה (16 tracks) it takes about half a percent a year, 0.54%–0.61%, and nothing on deposits, while the law allows up to 1.05%. But I didn't see anything that says it's as safe as a deposit, and I didn't see all the products, so I'll ask my son or the bank before I do anything.
